quote: Shelah introduced pcf theory and began formulating problems regarding 2^ℵ_ω in his 1978 paper 'Jonsson algebras in successor cardinals' (Israel Journal of Mathematics, vol. 30)
note: The problem about 2^(ℵ_ω) when ℵ_ω is a strong limit cardinal emerges from Shelah's PCF (possible cofinalities) theory development beginning in 1978. The 1983 survey paper 'The Singular Cardinals Problem: Independence Results' (Surveys in Set Theory, Cambridge University Press, pp. 116-134) explicitly formulates related open problems. The specific conjecture 'is 2^(ℵ_ω) < ℵ_(ω_1)?' crystallized in the literature by 1997-1999 (Gitik). The project database attribution 'Solovay, 1974' appears to be a recalled conflation; Silver proved a related theorem in 1974, but the specific ℵ_ω problem originates from Shelah's 1978+ work.
